research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Socure is researching stateless account authentication provable by a cryptographic biometric key, enabling recovery of user access through persistent unique identifiers. It develops generative systems and methods of feature extraction for enhancing entity matching, plus machine learning systems and methods for watchlist identity resolution and contextual decision making. Further work includes ai and vector based identity resolution, predictive document verification, fraud detection, barcode readability, and transaction score normalization. These efforts span digital identity, fraud mitigation, data extraction, and scoring.
